In detail

Buckow Nord is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Neukölln. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 12,305 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 1,200 cases recorded for the year, close to the citywide average. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Buckow Nord safe?

Wandroz currently rates Buckow Nord in Berlin, Germany as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Berlin, Germany, based on Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl). This source has no time-of-day breakdown, so this is one overall level rather than a separately measured day and night figure — see the note on this page before treating the day/night badges as independently measured.

Does Buckow Nord's rating cover night-time safety specifically?

Not separately. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl) publishes one figure per zone with no time-of-day split, so Buckow Nord's day and night badges show the same underlying level rather than an independently measured night figure. Treat it as a general indicator, not a night-specific measurement.

Is Buckow Nord a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Buckow Nord's rating is a useful general indicator, but this data is normalised against registered residents, not visitor footfall — busy tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher without that meaning elevated risk for a visitor passing through. What official data is Buckow Nord's rating based on?

Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas (Häufigkeitszahl), covering Buckow Nord's real administrative boundary. This is a genuine official dataset, not a qualitative judgment or press research — see the methodology page for the exact figures, the year they cover, and how the rate is calculated.
